propositions: review_interrupts metric is published dimensionless and cannot distinguish between bound-exceeded (bot is busy) and signal-unavailable (health probe is broken) causes, requiring shell access to diagnose
two new dimensionless metrics review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable must be emitted by observability.sh by splitting the existing marker on the reason field

two separate CloudWatch alarms must replace the single review_interrupts alarm, each carrying only its own remediation, keeping 900s/1-datapoint/Sum>0 cadence so signal-unavailable remains promptly triggered
the rolled-up review_interrupts metric must continue to be published but not alarmed, preserving pre-split history and handling future reasons
the split must be proven by an automated test driving the real observability.sh over a synthetic journal including the bound-exceeded-only case that previously required SSM access to diagnose
terraform apply must be executed to activate the new alarm contract on the live infrastructure
